payer.identityBasis: Modeled local disbursement view for represented saved awards, with zero prepaid stock. It is not an observed local Treasury account, appropriation or plan-membership record; the genuine due flow must be admitted by the owning finance provider.

citation: Fictional pre-start covered-work/claim/award generation remains estimated from saved birth, household, school/cohort and canonical trait context. SSA 2021 COLA factsheet, linked by the October 13, 2020 announcement, gives an estimated average retired-worker monthly amount payable in January 2021 of $1,543 after COLA (https://www.ssa.gov/news/en/cola/factsheets/2021.html). This is a source-reported average estimate, not an observed individual benefit, actual legal entitlement, cash stock or jurisdiction appropriation. New modeled local paying accounts start at zero; dated outside payments require kernel admission. The first bill on the first day of the following month and subsequent fixed-day monthly successors are an explicitly estimated calendar prior, not the sourced SSA insured-worker cycling/holiday calendar.
generationPriorVintage: SSA estimated January 2021 average payable, released with the October 13, 2020 COLA announcement; current canonical person/location context remains a modeled opening proxy.
placeCitation: Canonical accepted LifePlace record from src/simulation/life-places.ts; recent locality/jurisdiction identities are opening location proxies, not proof of historical public funding authority.

reasons.generated: Generated coherent covered-work and claim context supports the explicitly modeled opening award; no historical earnings or contemporaneous legal entitlement is claimed.
reasons.recorded: Preserved the saved monthly award and bound its actual finite payer; no second award or opening stock was created.
reasons.tooEarly: The model claim date is not before opening; no future claim or award was seeded.
reasons.currentWork: Current owned work is preserved; concurrent retirement-income and earnings rules are not modeled by this producer.
reasons.missingContext: Birth date alone supplies no covered-work or retirement context; no income was awarded.
reasons.missingPlace: No actual named place record resolves this retirement context; no payer label or account was invented.
reasons.insufficientCoverage: Recorded or generated covered-work context does not meet the model qualification; no award was added.
reasons.inactiveClaim: A saved claim or award is not in payment; generated history cannot override it.
reasons.missingPayer: The saved award has no admitted actual payer account; its private fact is preserved without a phantom payment route.
reasons.generationDisabled: Past generation was disabled and no qualified saved award/context supplies an income route.

gaps: Individual indexed earnings, credits, actual SSA eligibility/insured-worker linkage and territory/plan crosswalk remain estimated; a source average cannot establish an individual award.

Current fixed-calendar monthly due terms are modeled. Actual SSA payment cycling uses the insured worker birth date and exceptions; January 3, 2021 cycle-one payments were paid December 31, 2020 and must not be paid again after opening.
New generated local disbursement accounts carry no prepaid award reserve; genuine incoming flow and current source admission remain a root finance/journal requirement.
